newsitem.title: USA: Von Hoffmann Press plans $75 million debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Von Hoffmann Press plans $75 million debt offer.

text.p: Von Hoffmann Press Inc will sell $75 million in 10-year senior subordinated notes via Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette as part of a leveraged buyout of the company, sources said.

In the buyout transaction, a DLJ investment partnership will pay $66.6 million to purchase 83 percent the new company, an undisclosed amount of 13-1/2 percent senior exchangeable preferred stock and warrants to purchase additional stock, according to a confidential prospectus for the debt issue.
The buyout is also being financed via proceeds from the high-yield offering and and a $151.3 million loan.
Following the merger, Robert A. Uhlenhop, the company's president and chief executive officer, will hold about four percent of the company's common stock, the prospectus said.
A Von Hoffmann official contacted on Tuesday said he did "not comment on matters of speculation."
Von Hoffmann Press, based in St. Louis, Missouri, is the nation's largest manufacturer of four-color hardbound and softbound educational textbooks.
